title: Grip tier and sight effect-flag source review

remainingUncertainty: Byte-backed source operands show field values and selected asset routes, not multiplayer runtime activation or composition.
Where the selector route has no direct scalar for a modeled leaf, retain the exact per-leaf status in the external ledger; absence of a matching scalar is not proof of runtime absence.
17 of 167 leaves use per-weapon frostyModifiers; comparisons apply effective override values.
evidenceLimits: Descriptor-derived EBX bytes validate stored fields, not runtime consumption.
Selector presence does not prove multiplayer activation.
noEffect is an Analyzer UI flag, not a Frosty boolean or proof of no gameplay effect.
Suffixed VSSM ids without site availability are not inferred from names.
Field_b30a73ed runtime semantics remain unknown. The 12-frame/condition indicator evidence supports retaining the site zero but cannot name the native array target.
